problem_text:
A regional telecommunications company must dispatch a technician to inspect eight critical network nodes.  

The latencies between nodes, measured in milliseconds, are as follows:  
* Node P to Q: 104.0 ms  
* Node P to R: 26.9 ms  
* Node P to S: 114.8 ms  
* Node P to T: 129.1 ms  
* Node P to U: 14.6 ms  
* Node P to V: 87.0 ms  
* Node P to W: 76.6 ms  
* Node Q to R: 78.4 ms  
* Node Q to S: 98.2 ms  
* Node Q to T: 92.5 ms  
* Node Q to U: 117.2 ms  
* Node Q to V: 78.6 ms  
* Node Q to W: 32.3
